note: The controlling printed proper and same-edition RG 115 d conclusion form the selected reading. The digital Sacratissimae opening is a substantive variant, not a printing error. Proper-page cue and expanded conclusion have distinct source scopes.

adjudicated.ruling: Retain Sanctíssimæ from the controlling Benziger proper, independently corroborated by the Vatican printed proper. Sacratíssimæ is the pinned digital reading; it is not a typographical slip attributed to either printed book.

The j-form against this edition's i-form, by the house rule in ORTHOGRAPHY.md. This edition prints i because the books it edits do: the approved 1962 Benziger printing sets Iesu, Ioánnem, iube and maiestátis throughout, and so does the Ordo Missae of Pallottinum, Poznań 1963, which is the book a Polish reader is most likely to hold. The mid-century hand missals print j; neither spelling is a different word, and the apparatus records theirs.
